race.description: Langhorne Creek Wine Region Vignerons Cup Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: MOSTLY FOR SHOW (7) is the one to beat after some strong runs in town this prep. The 1350m still asks a question but Toeroek knows him well and his recent ratings give him the right platform. Listed winner MARACOURT (1) resumes with two trials behind him and shoulders peaks that would blow them away but he's proven a very tricky customer to catch recently. Goes well over this trip and has to be taken seriously. SIR LEAPALOT (8) hasn't been far away in stronger Saturday races, owns two wins at this track and gains a 3kg claim, so a win is within reach. JANDAMI (5) resumes from a three-month break after two BM74 runs where he covered ground and kept making ground. His Naracoorte trial plus barrier one give him a solid fresh platform. BIG SUE (4) doesn't have to improve much to also have a say in the finish.
